text:
The Juniper planning summary for 3–10 November sets corrected values that supersede earlier drafts: quota batch_size 900 and checkout ttl_s 360. Hard rules forbid search depending on feed, sync depending on media, and any session-to-ledger or archive-to-ingest dependency. Checkout and sync cannot share a worker, nor can export and feed. Ingest and checkout may share a worker, as may shipping and upload. Catalog/shipping and billing/checkout must run on separate workers.

Required ordering: metrics before reports, feed before scheduler, quota before session, and checkout before shipping.

Ownership: media on alpha; alerts, inventory, and catalog on beta; reports and profile on gamma; metrics and ledger on delta.

Retries: feed is fixed at 9 and sync at 8. Pricing is set at 6 per client requirement. If feed exceeds 6, shipping must be 1 or less.

Open items: a month-end security review, a budget review moved to next Thursday, and a suggested client demo.
